correctness.rationale: The Markov stationary run length is exactly geometric, independent of Gaussian noises. Perfect observation zeros one coordinate and gives unobserved variance C(B^K-1); exact tails, moment thresholds and mean follow. Uniform two-tail domination justifies Gaussian scale-mixture phase limit. Mellin transform and zero-free gamma prove all Fourier coefficients nonzero. Strict convexity verifies unique switching-price optimizer; exact rational tests and independent quadrature were executed.

value.rationale: Quantifies a concrete uncertainty feature in intermittently observed unstable systems: an exact, nonconstant log-periodic tail multiplier persists despite Gaussian process noise. Supplies all Fourier modes and a sharp switching-price frontier for a natural two-sensor Markov policy design, while clearly delimiting scope. The motivating closest 2019 article explicitly identifies arithmetic coefficients as difficult.
